audienceTruth: People already have the raw material; the hard part is choosing what matters and shaping it into something worth watching.
culturalTruth: Modern communication is increasingly audiovisual, short, vertical, fragmented and distributed across platforms.
businessTruth: Montage reduces the distance between footage and a finished story by automating organization, selection and assembly while preserving human review.
designTranslation: The visual system begins with fragments, frames and crops that align, sequence or resolve into a unified composition.
interactionTranslation: Bring in fragments, clarify intent, let the system prepare, review one coherent result, export.
